what: The Lean intake of Daniel Puri's proof (danielpuri1901/erdos-lean-formalization; formal-conjectures PR #7660, open since 2026-10-28, no review yet) against DeepMind's statement of MathOverflow 75792 (integer complexity of 3^n), decided from the run's facts by tools/lean-intake.js (phase P1 of notes/lean-fidelity-plan-2026-11-09.md). CERTIFIED here says: the kernels named accept the claimant's proof as a proof of the canonical declaration's own statement, the check refuses every planted wrong statement and accepts every planted paraphrase, the canonical hypotheses have a model, and every planted defect in the claimant's file is caught. The spec was written by claimbox (python3 -m claimbox intake spec corpus/intake/mo-75792/target.json: every planted statement by a fixed rule, only certain outcomes predicted — "kernel decides" otherwise), copied here by LIFT-claimbox-intake.json and committed before the run.
notDecided: Whether the canonical statement is the informal problem (a reading, F5; F2, instance agreement, is phase P2); the kernels not run: leanchecker-paranoid, lean4lean, con-leche, con-ron (not bundled with v4.33.1).
